Glad you got the tests passing. I saved this to the project's memory store as a hazard: newer wkhtmltopdf versions fail the invoice PDF tests unless you pass `--enable-local-file-access`. If someone hits this on a new machine or after an upgrade, the fix will come up for them.

You said the fix is only local so far. If it's in code or config rather than your own setup, you may want to commit it so CI and others get it too.
